'''FK Mladost''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: ФК Mлaдocт Гaцкo) is a [[football (soccer)|football]] club from the town of [[Gacko]], in [[Republika Srpska]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club played in the [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] in the [[2002–03 Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina|2002-03]] season. However, due to poor results FK Mladost was relegated to the [[First League of the Republika Srpska]]."}}
